title: Printed Page Numbers by PDF Page Number
description: Maps each pdf_page_number to its corresponding printed_page_number(s) for each issue. Derived from human-reviewed anchor points via the trains_magazine_extractor page-number inference pipeline.

issues.description: Map from IssueKey to page mapping data.

printed_page_numbers_by_pdf_page_number.description: Maps a pdf_page_number (as a numeric string key) to one or more printed_page_numbers. Single-element lists for normal pages; multi-element for gatefold pages that span multiple printed pages. Chrome and cover pages without a printed_page_number are omitted.
